forbidden_dependencies: Every relative, absolute, dynamic, require, diagnostics-subpath, retired-tree, candidate-cross-import, or other package import is rejected. The pinned package-lock and parse-that dist ledger close the only transitive runtime dependency.
ledger_format: UTF-8/LF. Each line is `<lowercase sha256><two spaces><mirror-relative path>\n`; paths are sorted by raw UTF-8 byte order.
overlay_algorithm: The overlay contains exactly one valid UTF-8 file at target_path. Its ledger is exactly one ledger-format line using the source SHA-256.
projection_algorithm: Parse and validate the frozen base ledger, reject an existing target_path, append the overlay row, byte-sort by path, serialize with exactly one LF per row and no other bytes, then SHA-256 the serialized bytes.
candidate_identity: source SHA-256 + overlay-ledger SHA-256 + projected grammar-ledger SHA-256
integration: Apply the selected source bytes verbatim at target_path, recompute the complete grammar ledger by the same format, and require the selected projected hash before semantic/type/benchmark replay.
drift_rule: Any base drift, target collision, extra import/path, formatter rewrite, source-byte change, or projected mismatch starts a new generation.
base_disposition: The base records the current rejected grammar only as a drift witness and grants it no architecture or conformance credit. Its later retirement is a distinct aggregate change requiring replay.
